name: Send a good morning message to a Slack channel every weekday
description: Posts a good morning message to a Slack channel at 9:00 every Monday to Friday. Change the hour, the days, the time zone or the text to fit your team.
shortDescription: Greet your team in Slack at the start of every working day.
keyFeatures: Runs on a schedule at 9:00 on Monday to Friday, in the time zone you choose
Posts to any public or private channel the Slack app has been added to
Two steps, so it is easy to extend: add a weather report, today's calendar or open tickets before the message
prerequisites: A Slack connection in ByteChef, with the ByteChef Slack app added to the channel you post to
The channel to post to, picked in the Send good morning message step
Your team's time zone, set in the schedule trigger (it ships as UTC)
idealFor: Team leads who want a daily check-in prompt in Slack without posting it by hand.
steps: Trigger: run at 9:00 on Monday to Friday.
Post the good morning message to the chosen Slack channel.
